slides.texte_overlay:
Underrated hobbies
that sharpen your mind
Playing Go. An ancient strategy game with simple rules and endless depth. It teaches patience and long-term thinking.
Building a small electronics project. A lamp, a radio, a simple robot. You learn logic and problem solving with your hands.
Learning about wine, coffee or tea. Tasting carefully trains your senses, memory and vocabulary. Start with one tasting this week.
Hiking with a map. Planning routes, reading terrain and finding your way keeps your brain alert and your body strong.
Daily micro-learning. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and it adds depth to every hobby I try.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. It adds depth to every hobby I try.

slides.texte_overlay: Writing poems or song lyrics. Playing with words trains creativity and helps you express what you feel. Ten minutes is enough.
Restoring an old bike or watch. Taking something apart and putting it back together teaches precision and patience.
